meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: Claude 会用 shadcn 命令行管理你的 UI 组件和项目：查项目配置、搜索和安装组件、取组件文档与示例、按规则写样式和组合界面（含聊天界面），并处理 preset 代码。
howto.when: 当你提到 shadcn/ui、组件注册表、--preset 等，或项目里存在 components.json 文件，以及要求 shadcn init、用 --preset 建应用或切换 preset 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 shadcn 初始化这个项目，指定 --preset 代码
从 @shadcn 注册表加一个 login block
say.note: 确认注册表后安装该 block

say.text: 检查我刚加的组件有没有违反组合规则，顺手修好导入
say.note: 会读新增文件并修正问题

howto.what_en: Claude manages your shadcn/ui components and project through the shadcn CLI: reads project config, searches and installs components, fetches docs and examples, writes styles and composes UI (including chat), and handles preset codes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention shadcn/ui, component registries or --preset codes, when the project has a components.json file, or for shadcn init, --preset app creation or preset switching.

say_en.text: Initialize this project with shadcn using a --preset code
Add a login block from the @shadcn registry
say_en.note: Installs the block after registry is set

say_en.text: Check the component I just added for rule issues and fix imports
say_en.note: Reads added files and fixes problems
